visual_elements.description: Self-attention data-flow diagram inside one peach rounded container. LEFT: tan label 'KEYs' above a vertical stack of 4 identical vector bars — each a green dashed rounded rectangle split into 4 abutting segments (pale yellow, pink, pale green, pale violet) with a red subscripted 'X₂' on the 2nd segment; red circle badge 'K' to the right of the stack. CENTER-LEFT: vertical gray-tan rectangle titled 'Dot Product' (dark red, two lines) containing 4 blue circular nodes (dark-blue ring, light-blue center) on a slight diagonal; red arrows run from each of the 4 KEY bars to its node and from each node rightward into the Softmax box; line weights vary — 3rd arrow thickest, 2nd medium, 1st and 4th thin — encoding relevance percentage (no numeric percentages printed). CENTER: vertical orchid-pink rounded rectangle with 'Soft max' rotated 90°. CENTER-RIGHT: vertical column of 4 small red-outlined circles each containing an asterisk (multiply nodes), black labels W₂₁, W₂₂, W₂₃, W₂₄ at their left; red arrows from the Softmax right edge to each node, horizontal red arrows from each of the 4 Value bars leftward into each node, and red arrows rising from each node into the Σ box. TOP-CENTER-RIGHT: pale-blue rectangle with large black 'Σ'; thick green arrow from Σ top up into the output vector — a green dashed bar with segments pale yellow, pink, pale green labeled 'Y' (green bold), pale gray-green. RIGHT: tan label 'Values' above a stack of 4 vector bars identical to the KEYs; red circle badge 'V' at left of stack. BOTTOM-LEFT: orange rounded box 'Query / ALL Keys with X₂' with red circle badge 'Q' at its right; below it a horizontal row of 4 vector bars where the 2nd bar is filled magenta with magenta 'X₂'; a thick red arrow points up into that highlighted bar; a red dashed curved arrow runs from the row's left end up to the bottom of the KEYs stack (query matched against all keys).

imagery: No photographs or illustrations; all graphics are flat PowerPoint-style vector shapes: colored segment bars (key/value/query vectors), dashed green containers, blue node circles, red asterisk-in-circle multiply nodes, block/line arrows, rounded label boxes, and circular K/Q/V badges

accents: #D40000 (red emphasis words, arrows, badges, X₂ labels)

typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Calibri-like). Title bold ~26-28pt on line 1, second line slightly smaller (~18-20pt) and also bold; yellow highlight behind the title's parenthetical; selected words in the subtitle colored red with a true subscript 2 in X₂. All diagram labels bold ~12-14pt; callout text bold italic; 'Soft max' rotated 90° to read vertically; W₂₁-W₂₄ and X₂ use subscripted numerals; result-box text mixes bold-italic emphasis words with regular blue text; slide number is small plain text in a circle. No serif fonts, no all-caps styling beyond what is transcribed (KEYs, VALUES, ALL as written).
animation_state: Slide appears fully built and static: all four key/value pairs, all arrows, both callouts, the result box and all labels are visible simultaneously; no mid-build (partial bullet reveal) state detected.
recreation_brief: 1. Create a 16:9 slide with white background; draw a dark-red (#990000) rounded-rectangle border ~3pt inset ~0.15in from every edge. 2. Centered at top, one text box, bold Arial ~26pt black: 'Self Attention Mechanism ' followed by '(as Query and {Key-Value} Dictionary)' with yellow (#FFFF00) text highlight on that parenthetical. 3. Second centered line beneath, bold Arial ~18pt: '(Query using X₂ All Keys in Dictionary and retrieve Corresponding Values' — color 'Query', 'X₂', 'All Keys' and 'Values' red (#D40000); make the 2 in X₂ subscript. 4. Top-right: yellow (#FFFF00) circle ~0.45in with thin dark outline, dark text '29'. 5. Main panel: peach (#FBDFBD) rounded rectangle from just under the subtitle to the bottom border, ~92% of slide width, thin dark-red outline. 6. Build one vector bar: green (#00A651) dashed rounded rectangle ~1.7in x 0.38in containing 4 abutting segments colored #FFFF99, #FF99CC, #99FF66, #E6C8E6, with red subscripted 'X₂' over the 2nd segment; duplicate 11 times — 4 stacked vertically left (KEYs), 4 stacked vertically right (Values), 4 in a horizontal row bottom-left. 7. One extra bar top-center-right = output vector; recolor its 3rd segment green and label it 'Y' in green bold. 8. Tan (#E8C79A) rounded label boxes with dark-red bold text: 'KEYs' above the left stack, 'Values' above the right stack. 9. Dot Product: gray-tan (#CDBBA8) vertical rectangle ~1.1in x 3.6in center-left with dark-red two-line title 'Dot / Product' at top; inside, 4 blue nodes (~0.18in circles, #003399 ring, #6699FF fill) on a slight diagonal. 10. Red (#C00000) arrows from each KEY bar to its node and from each node to the Softmax box; vary weights ~1.5pt, ~3pt, ~4.5pt, ~1.5pt top-to-bottom (encodes relevance; no numbers shown). 11. Softmax: orchid (#DFA0DF) vertical rounded rectangle ~0.5in x 3.6in at center with dark-red bold 'Soft max' rotated 90°. 12. Multiply column: 4 small red-outlined circles (~0.22in) each containing a red asterisk, stacked center-right; black subscripted labels W₂₁, W₂₂, W₂₃, W₂₄ at their left; red arrows from Softmax to each node, horizontal red arrows from each Value bar into each node, and red arrows from each node up into the Σ box. 13. Σ box: pale-blue (#CCE4FF) rectangle ~1.5in x 0.35in above the column with black bold 'Σ' ~24pt; thick green (#00A651) arrow from its top up into the output vector. 14. Two light-cyan (#CCFFFF) rounded callouts with magenta (#CC00CC) bold italic ~12pt text: 'Matched KEYS with / Relevance Percentage' (above Dot Product) and 'Retrieve VALUES / Weighted by their Relevance' (top-right). 15. Query area: orange (#FAC090) rounded box bottom-left with dark-red bold 'Query' and smaller 'ALL Keys with X₂'; red-outlined circle badges with red bold letters: 'K' right of the KEYs stack, 'Q' right of the Query box, 'V' left of the Values stack; in the bottom bar row fill the 2nd bar magenta (#FF7CCE) with magenta 'X₂'; add a thick red arrow pointing up into it and a red dashed curved arrow from the row's left end up to the KEYs stack. 16. Result box: white rectangle ~2.9in x 0.75in with 2pt blue (#0000CC) border at bottom-right; centered blue text on three lines: 'Values of Matched Keys' (bold italic on 'Values' and 'Matched Keys'), 'are returned', 'when Running Query'.
